author: Tobias Jakobs
name: slideshowMusic
description: Plays background music through the Rhythmbox client while darktable's slideshow view is active.
description-extensive: This add-on adds a little atmosphere to darktable's full-screen slideshow by playing music while your photos are shown. When you leave the slideshow, the music stops on its own. It relies on the Rhythmbox music player (rhythmbox-client), so it is intended for Linux users.
